scope: Active compile-time percussion bank for firmware01 Lumiere; zero tonal EEPROM bytes. Existing hi-hat preserved. tools/build-rhythmic.py calls compile_source after instrument specialization.

acoustic-bass-drum.label: FluidR3 GM35 acoustic bass drum, compact triangle

envelope.schedule: Existing R21 bit shifts, popcount(stage): levels1,1/2,1/2,1/4; one/two global ticks until first transition.

limitations: Fixed73.242Hz triangle; source body/impact/pitch trajectory and long sample tail are approximated.

noise-snare-legacy.label: Previous noise-only snare

envelope.schedule: Existing R21 bit shifts, popcount(stage): levels1,1/2,1/2,1/4; one/two global ticks until first transition.

limitations: Reference for regression; lacks the low-frequency snare body prominent in FluidR3 GM38.

body-snare-full-noise.label: Measured comparison: full noise plus triangle body

envelope.schedule: Existing R21 bit shifts, popcount(stage): levels1,1/2,1/2,1/4; one/two global ticks until first transition.

limitations: Body is146.484Hz, not exact source~180Hz; same short legacy decay for tone and noise.

acoustic-snare-soft-body.label: Selected soft acoustic snare: half noise plus triangle body

envelope.schedule: Existing R21 bit shifts, popcount(stage): levels1,1/2,1/2,1/4; one/two global ticks until first transition.

limitations: Measured approximation; body146.484Hz, source body~180Hz. Higher partials and original sample tail are not exact.

closed-hi-hat.label: Existing Lumiere natural closed hi-hat

envelope.schedule: Existing R21 bit shifts, popcount(stage): levels1,1/2,1/2,1/4; one/two global ticks until first transition.

limitations: Preserved unchanged; compact high-pass-like noise, not metallic sample playback; four-step decay remains coarse.

selection.hiHat: Existing working Lumiere generator retained with identical LFSR, bit extraction and shifts.
selection.snare: Half noise plus R15 triangle body selected after comparison with retained GM38 band power; phase offset-64 starts body nearzero without another state byte.
selection.kick: Existing slower kick retained; earlier measured distance0.222 against GM35 versus1.164 for the original high kick.
selection.implementation: Active firmware01:1016 Flash bytes,730 code bytes. Selected snare adds22bytes versus legacy using existing R15/R27; zeroadditionalSRAM/EEPROM. Builder records selected kit, attenuation, resolved hits and profile SHA256.

midiSources.lumiere: Hand-arranged score, generated natural-kit pattern; no retained sourceMIDI drum channel.

children.adaptation: Current piano/bass arrangement intentionally omits percussion; GM36/44 are not silently relabelled35/42.
